summary: Verified Kagane patched APK v1.6.33 served from static /kagane/ path. All 5 backend assertions in the review request pass: HTTP download, SHA256 match, non-debug signing cert (CN=Jo Private Extensions), APK structure parity with official 1.6.32 (only versionCode/Name differ), presence of new 'books/index' endpoint string in classes.dex, and source diff correctness in Kagane.kt / Dto.kt.

2_signing_cert.details: apksigner verify: Verifies=true, v2 scheme=true. V2 Signer DN = 'CN=Jo Private Extensions, O=Jo Private' (NOT 'CN=Android Debug'). SHA-256 digest=e2b9220aba679d713db81ac3356abef5c3f5f480d837e387b2d578977bfe66b6, RSA 4096. v1 JAR scheme false (same as official keiyoushi which uses v2 only).

3_apk_structure_vs_1_6_32.details: Both contain AndroidManifest.xml, classes.dex, res/, resources.arsc, META-INF. aapt2 badging: package='eu.kanade.tachiyomi.extension.all.kagane' identical; versionCode 106032->106033, versionName 1.6.32->1.6.33 — only expected differences. minSdk=26, targetSdk=37, label 'Tachiyomi: Kagane' identical.

4_books_index_in_dex.details: strings classes.dex of 1.6.33 contains '/books/index?fields=List' (1 occurrence). 1.6.32 dex has 0 occurrences — confirms new chapter endpoint is embedded.

5_source_diff_sanity.details: Kagane.kt fetchMangaUpdate: when fetchChapters=false, returns existing `chapters` (else branch). When fetchDetails=false, returns `manga` unchanged (else branch). Chapters fetched via `$apiUrl/series/$seriesId/books/index?fields=List`, parsed via `.parseAs<BookIndexDto>().toBooks()`. BookIndexDto defined in Dto.kt with toBooks() that zips fields+row and constructs ChapterDto.Book list. versionCode bumped 32->33 in build.gradle.kts.

critical_code_review_comments: Signing: APK is now signed with personal release key (CN=Jo Private Extensions) using v2-only scheme, matching upstream keiyoushi's signing scheme. This should resolve Google Play Protect 'harmful' warning that was caused by the generic Android Debug cert.

Note: v1 (JAR) scheme is false; only v2 is used. This matches upstream so is intentional — but if any downstream Mihon version requires v1, re-sign with --v1-signing-enabled. Current state matches official 1.6.32 APK scheme.
context_for_next_testing_agent: This is a static APK hosted at /app/frontend/public/kagane/. No UI/API to test. Live Kagane API (kagane.org) is behind Cloudflare and unreachable from env — functional chapter-fetching can only be verified by installing the APK on a device. All build/signing/source assertions pass.
